newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: Hyundai Corp sets 2-for-5 rights offer.
newsitem.headline: Hyundai Corp sets 2-for-5 rights offer.

text.p: South Korea's Hyundai Corp said on Thursday it would offer a two-for-five rights issue in May to raise operating funds.
The issue will increase paid-in capital to 73.5 billion won from 49 billion at present.

A Hyundai statement said the company plans to issue 4.9 million new common shares, of which 20 percent would be first offered to its employees. The rest will be allocated to shareholders registered as of April 7 for rights.
The issue price will be set at a 25 percent discount to the base price, which will be decided later.
Shareholders' subscription is scheduled for May 6 and 7, with payment due by May 9.
Hyundai shares closed down 500 won at 14,300 on Thursday.
